changes.independentDetailLane: Company/person proxy failures no longer put every independent entity behind the initial repair-heavy prefix. Queue entries remain pending on failure; verification ordering is preserved.
changes.tableOnlySSR: Nonempty tables without linked entity rows no longer trigger redundant browser navigation, scrolling and reload.
changes.additionalTransport: Public SOCKS5 candidates can use proxy-side DNS with validated HTTPS. Same 4-request observed-exit budget; no credentials or direct fallback.
changes.embeddedNotices: Extract public notice body text from already-loaded company DOM, require explicit company identity and unambiguous News link, redact personal identifiers, retain changed text variants and source receipts. No additional site request.
changes.modernOfficialRoute: Bounded official-source assessment now includes https://rrk.ir/ords/f?p=200:199 instead of relying on legacy ASP.NET list paths. No third-party sessions, CAPTCHA handling, form POSTs or authentication replay. Stop on 401/403/429.

productionValidation.note: Do not count test passes, successful workflow status, or previously imported notice texts as new production data. Inspect final run receipts and Git blobs before reporting throughput.
